name: Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity / Diameter (Incomparable)
details: Neither parameter admits a universal affine-linear upper bound in terms of the other, even for finite binary classes.
parameter_1_larger_witness: For $\mathcal S_n$, proper equivalence-query complexity is $n-1$, while diameter is $2$.
parameter_2_larger_witness: For $\mathcal T_n=\{\emptyset,[n]\}$, diameter is $n$, while proper equivalence-query complexity is $1$.
proof: The two canonical value calculations give unbounded gaps in the two directions.
proof_source: Database-owned value proofs for Proper Equivalence Queries Complexity and Diameter of Trivial Concepts and Singletons.
